data.title: Fed report cites 'stepped-up' inflation due to tariffs, Iran war, AI buildout
data.description: U.S. inflation "stepped up further this spring" as the ​evolving impact of tariffs, a war-related rise in energy costs, and the booming artificial intelligence buildout boosted price pressures that took root last year, the Federal Reserve said on Friday ‌in a monetary policy report to Congress.
